hooks.name: Code Review on Write
hooks.description: Quick code review after the agent writes or edits a file (ECC code-review-on-write, current Kiro format).

action.prompt: Code was just written or modified. Perform a quick review checking for: 1) Common security issues (SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets), 2) Error handling, 3) Code clarity and maintainability, 4) Potential bugs or edge cases. Only comment if you find issues worth addressing.
